newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST- ICA seen posting weak Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- ICA seen posting weak Q3 results.

text.p: Empresas ICA S.A., Mexico's largest construction firm, will report third quarter financial results that reflect weak operating results, analysts said.
A survey by Reuters of five analysts found an average forecast of 1.07 pesos per share in the third quarter. ICA reported first half net earnings of 375.77 million pesos.
Analysts said that these forecasts did not include extraordinary earnings from the sale by ICA of two hotels during the quarter, which will bring in net cash of $15 million.
"The third quarter results will probably not be well received by investors," said Salomon Brothers analyst Carmen Slade.
Analysts adjusted their estimates partly because ICA has said since August its third quarter results would not be good.
"The margins are going to be a bit better than in the second quarter, but we don't see better income increases, and the backlog has been dropping compared with June," said Slade.
Bear Stearns analyst Sobani Warner said that expectations of a weak quarterly report had been behind weakness in ICA's ADR in the last weeks.
She said that the third quarter will not going to be good for ICA, but added that the market has already discounted that in the price of the share.
Warner said that income could rise 15 percent against the third quarter of 1995, but against the second quarter it will still be weak.
Monica Lourdes of BBV-Probursa said that the third quarter report could be a little better than the second quarter, as there has been some increase in sales.
She said income could be helped by several new projects.

A report by Flemings Research analyst Ben Uglow said that they were looking at an operating margin of 5.0 percent, compared with 4.2 percent in the second quarter and 10.2 percent in the third quarter of 1995. He said this reflected a shrinking margins due to intense competition.
